occurrenceRemarks: SPECIES: Birdbeaked Burrfish, Cyclichthys orbicularis (Bloch, 1785)[1] OTHER NAMES: DATE, TIME: 18 March 2023, 12:52 PM LOCALITY: Fins Beach, Muscat, Oman LATITUDE, LONGITUDE: 22.9287, 59.2111 DISTRIBUTION: Temperate and tropical seas worldwide. SIMILAR SPECIES: Members of the genus Diodon have moveable spines with 2 roots, not fixed spines with 3. Spotbase Burrfish, Cyclichthys spilostylus (Leis & Randall, 1982), Spines are too small. Hardenburg’s Burrfish, Cyclichthys hardenbergi (de Beaufort, 1939), does not occur in Oman or anywhere close by. USE: Consumed as an exotic delicacy (Fugu) that can cause Tetrodotoxin poisoning, which may be fatal. A skilled chef’s preparation causes a mild tingling and a feeling of euphoria. This fish may also have Ciguatera Poison. JUVENILE MASS AGGREGATIONS:[2] Occur in Long-spine Porcupinefish, Diodon holacanthus Linnaeus, 1758, sometimes every 9 years in the U. S. Virgin Islands or so but with seemingly without rhyme or reason (Rogers, 2013; ). The fish are around 3-4 inches long and more than a year old (ibid), although a few of ours were smaller or larger. The reason or even ability for these aggregations is unknown (ibid). Porcupinefish Mass Aggregations probably occur more often and more widely. They are just not recognized and not reported. ADULT AGGREGATIONS: Many fishes aggregate for sexual reproduction or feeding but these are adult fish, not juveniles. Table 1. Mass aggregations of spiny puffers Location Fish sp. Water Body Year Reference Sri Lanka Black-blotched Porcupinefish Indian Ocean 1933 Kirtisinghe, 1934 Gulf of Oman, Oman Birdbeaked Burrfish Oman Gulf 2023 This note Black-blotched porcupinefish, Diodon liturosus Shaw, 1804 SHOALS: Contain fish attracted to one another but whose activities are only loosely coordinated. Juvenile Bowfin, plotosid catfishes, surgeonfishes, and pufferfishes form shoals but not mass aggregations. Randall et al. (2019) suggested a Long-spined Porcupinefish shoal exist offshore and the fish only move inshore to settle. Abnormally large shoals moving inshore could cause aggregations. MASS MORTALITY: EHW walked the beach and estimated ~10 k spiny puffers. The specimens included small and larger, dry white-bleached, older and smelly, deteriorating ones. Thus various size young specimens were killed over a period of days or weeks. Time was not available to examine other beaches. A continuing single-species mass mortality is very unusual as is a aggregation-mass mortality. OBSERVERS: Dr. Ernest H. occurrenceRemarks: 肩环刺盖鱼，又名环纹刺盖鱼，是鲈形目刺盖鱼科刺盖鱼属的鱼类。分布于印度西太平洋区，包括印度、斯里兰卡、马来西亚、泰国、柬埔寨、日本、中国、越南、菲律宾、印尼、新几内亚、所罗门群岛、马里亚纳群岛等海域皆有其踪迹，一般栖息于珊瑚礁。通常在洞穴里成对出现。稚鱼停驻于很浅的近海栖息地，在岩石或死珊瑚底部上有短的菌丝藻成长。属肉食性，以海绵与被囊类为食。 肩环刺盖鱼长度可达45厘米，鱼体略高而呈卵圆形，侧扁，吻短稍尖。体黄褐色，由胸鳍基部向后上方斜走至背鳍有5至7条蓝色环纹，幼鱼体是以蓝色镶以放射状的白线。背鳍与臀鳍软条部后端截平，腹鳍尖，第一软条延长，几达臀鳍，尾鳍钝圆形。
